newsitem.title: ITALY: German business interested in Stet - Prodi.
newsitem.headline: German business interested in Stet - Prodi.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said German financiers and industrialists were interested in investing in Italian state telecommunications holding Stet once it has been privatised.

Prodi, returning from a trip to Germany, was asked by reporters travelling with him late on Monday whether German business executives he met at dinner in Frankfurt were interested in taking part in the "stable core" of shareholders the government wants to attract for Stet.
He replied: "We didn't talk about particulars but they showed interest, as I imagined."

"They showed a lot of interest in our privatisation programme but I didn't go there to do business," he said,although he noted that companies like Siemens who had already taken part in Italian privatisations were present at the dinner.
Stet is due to be sold off in late 1997 once it has merged with state telecommunications operator Telecom Italia, an operation which is expected to be completed by June.
